basics.name: Yi-Cheng Lin
basics.label: PhD Student in Communication Engineering, National Taiwan University
basics.summary: Ph.D. student at National Taiwan University working on large audio-language models and fairness in speech processing, advised by Hung-yi Lee in the Speech Processing and Machine Learning Lab. 30+ papers at Interspeech, ICASSP, ASRU, SLT, ACL, EMNLP and IEEE TASLP with over 700 citations. Best Paper Runner-Up at Interspeech 2024.

work.name: ASRU AudioMOS Challenge 2025
work.summary: Automatic quality assessment of generated speech, music, and audio.
highlights: First place on 13 of 16 metrics in Track 1 — MOS prediction for text-to-music systems.
Top 3 places on 17 of 32 metrics in Track 2 — Audiobox-aesthetics-style prediction.
First place on 5 of 8 metrics in Track 3 — MOS prediction for speech at high sampling frequencies.

work.name: Microsoft Taiwan
highlights: Upgraded the geolocation prediction system from rule-based to ML-based, improving accuracy by 2% and reducing prediction time by 10%.

volunteer.summary: Conference and journal peer review in speech and language processing.
highlights: Conferences: ACL Rolling Review (Feb 2024, Oct 2024, Feb 2025, May 2025), INTERSPEECH 2025, ASRU 2025, ACML 2025, ICLR 2025, ROCLING 2025, ICASSP 2026.
Journals: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing; IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing.

courses: Speech Processing and Machine Learning Lab, advised by Hung-yi Lee
Selected courses: Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning for Human Language Processing
Transferred to the PhD program in Spring 2025
Double major in the Trans-disciplinary Bachelor Program (2021.09–2023.06)
Completed the Social Design, Leadership, and Quantum Computation & Quantum Information programs
